title: Faction skeleton - every line present, one quest deep
box_at_start: contention.mjs --gate exit 3 (4 browser instances, load 19.71 over 4 cores). All data/code/prose work first; browser phase last, via tools/capture/ if still over.

the_gap_measured_before_building.note_on_the_two_ones: the_dockhands and the_ixtu_vakh are joinable ONLY as a side effect of mainline Act IV (Q-MAIN-21 res_dockhand_rank, Q-MAIN-19 res_cutters_rank). That is the main quest's voice, not the faction's, and it is unreachable to a player who has not reached Act IV.
two_dead_rank_gates_found: blackmarsh-coast.json Q-SOUL-02 is rank_gate the_drowned_court min_rank 2 — and NOTHING in the build joins the_drowned_court, so that gate can never open.
blackmarsh-coast.json Q-SAP-01 is rank_gate the_ixtu_vakh min_rank 1 — reachable only via Act IV.

rulings_rule_0_decide_and_record.ruling: Width = every JOINABLE body has a joining route in its own voice. I author one joining quest each for the_rootkeepers, the_ixtu_vakh, the_drowned_court, the_dockhands. Four quests, rank 0 -> 1, no more.
rulings_rule_0_decide_and_record.what_would_overturn_it: A critic showing that the Act-IV route already counts as a joining route for the_dockhands / the_ixtu_vakh. Then delete those two quests; the Rootkeepers and the Drowned Court still had none by any reading.

rulings_rule_0_decide_and_record.ruling: deep_kin is a DUPLICATE ladder id for the Xul-Aneekh (faction-reactions.json aliases deep_kin -> xul-aneekh; FACTION-ROSTER-DESIGN resolved it). I build no line for it and delete nothing (deleting orphans Q-MAG-07). It is recorded as not-joinable in the roster of record.
rulings_rule_0_decide_and_record.what_would_overturn_it: Lore naming deep_kin as a body distinct from the Xul-Aneekh with its own hall.

rulings_rule_0_decide_and_record.ruling: I do NOT author a second quest per line. The rank-gating demonstration uses the TWO DEAD GATES already in the tree (Q-SOUL-02 at drowned_court r2, Q-SAP-01 at ixtu_vakh r1), which my joining quests bring to life. Width beats depth; the brief is explicit.
rulings_rule_0_decide_and_record.what_would_overturn_it: RI-QST01's mean-quests-per-rank hard fail being applied to a wave-1 skeleton line rather than to a carried line.

plan: 1. game/data/quests/faction-joining-wave1.json — 4 joining quests, one per missing line, each with a discoverable opens_by topic that already exists in the shipped topic set, >=2 resolutions, joins_faction, reputation >= the rank-1 demand of 10.
2. game/data/npcs/faction-recruiters.json — the four recruiters, with reaction_group (Engine._assertGiversAreVisibleToRace throws otherwise) and a real place.

3. Refusals IN VOICE: game/data/dialogue/faction-refusals.json + an engine reader that turns gate.evaluate()'s unmet terms into the recruiter's own words, exposed on the harness and rendered where a player sees it.
4. The crime seam for the two NEW joinables: sanction.json standing_ids + rows, standingKey() branches. check-data.mjs asserts both directions and will fail the commit if I skip it.
5. game/data/progression/factions.json — promote the wave-0 two-faction skeleton to the roster of record, with a world-side consumer.
6. tools/quests/faction-joining-probe.mjs — joinability measured THROUGH PLAY; CONSUMPTION by rank perturbation; delete-the-fix with a control that is checked for inertness.
7. index.json regen, gates, blog line, shot, commit.
